title: Route M3.4 Qualified Release Set exact-head CI
purpose: Teach the central Learn-it Next exact-head router to recognize the governed M3.4 Qualified Release Set product branch and delegate to its dedicated exact-head workflow instead of rejecting it as an unknown ci-router branch.
invariants: Only the central router and CI-WP-012 metadata change.
The M3.4 branch maps to one dedicated delegated profile.
The delegated profile validates exactly the M3.4 product pull-request branch and five expected product paths.
The delegated profile rejects changes to promoted M3.2, M3.2.5, M3.3, canonical-kit and Atlas validator authorities.
Existing route mappings and behaviors remain unchanged.
requiredEvidence: Generic ci-router audit accepts this CI-only router change.
Product PR #323 rerun reaches M3_4_RELEASE_SET_DELEGATED_ROUTE=PASS after this change is merged into its base.
adversarialTests: Unknown branch remains on ci-router and requires a workflow audit change.
M3.4 delegated profile rejects non-pull-request execution.
M3.4 delegated profile rejects an unexpected branch.
M3.4 delegated profile rejects any missing required product path.
M3.4 delegated profile rejects upstream authority changes.
nonGoals: Changing M3.3 product or routing semantics.
independentReview: Repository governance and PR scope gate this two-file CI-only change.
The M3.4 product PR is the acceptance target for the new delegated route.
rollback: Remove the M3.4 route case, delegated block and CI-WP-012 metadata; the central router returns to rejecting the M3.4 branch as unknown.
